species: OVCAR3 (ovarian cancer) cells were placed in 100mm × 20mm cell culture plates and treated with or without anti-human KRASG12D-IgA1 or KRASG12D-IgG4 or non-specific human IgA (Abcam, ab91025) at 0.5 μg/ml final concentration or vehicle (PBS) in low serum media. After 12 h, conditioned medium was collected and filtered for contaminant debris removal. Proteins were extracted from the conditioned medium, reduced by DTT, digested by trypsin, and subjected to mass spectrometry analysis by the Moffitt Cancer Center Proteomics Facility.
